app/(main)/about-us/page.greeting: We're David and Dumitru, we founded TheBakerz to make it easy for home bakers and artisan chefs to sell their products. We saw a growing market of passionate bakers and even more people hungry for something better than supermarket desserts. So we created a platform that brings them together. It's simple: bakers get tools to grow, customers get access to amazing goods. Win Win!
app/(main)/about-us/page.slogan: TheBakerz puts everything bakers need in one place. Instead of bouncing between spreadsheets, emails, and messages, you can handle all your orders, schedules, and customer details from a single, organized spot. Less hassle, fewer headaches, and more energy for doing what you do best—baking.
app/(main)/about-us/page.why: For us, TheBakerz isn't just another idea—it's a direct response to what our friends and family bakers told us they need. We're here to make it easier, so you can focus on what you love most. Follow us on social and let's shape a better future together.

app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer1: TheBakerz is an all-in-one platform that helps bakers manage their businesses and reach more customers. It handles advertising, orders, payments, and deliveries (for now only in Limburg area). Besides, we can help you set-up your bakery and comply with laws and regulations.
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer2: Getting started is easy! [Fill out this form](/become-partner#join-thebakerz), and we'll schedule a quick call to set everything up. We'll help you create your online shop and show you how to use it step by step. You'll just need a KVK number, VAT number, and food safety certification. If you're missing something, don't worry—we'll help you figure it out.
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer3: Of course! You're in control of what you sell and how much you charge. You can update your menu and prices whenever you like.
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer4: You can offer delivery or allow customers to pick up orders from your location. Set your own delivery areas and pick-up times to fit your schedule. Bakeries in Limburg can use TheBakerz's delivery service. This costs 20% commission of the order value (paid by the baker) and a small delivery fee (charged to the customer).
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer5: You pay only when you make a sale. We take an 8% commission, which covers website operations, payment processing fees, and advertising.
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer6: Customers pay upfront through our secure payment system. We transfer your earnings, minus the commission, to your bank account weekly. Payments typically arrive within 1-2 business days after Monday
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer7: Yes, you can. Orders are tracked automatically, and payments are processed securely with our payment partner (Stripe). Both you and your customers will have full transparency at every step.
app/(support)/components/faq-baker.answer8: We're here to help with anything you need. From setting up your shop to managing orders, contact us or call us at +31 684794739. We'll make sure everything runs smoothly for you.
